title: Corporate Rebels Summit, Amsterdam — Eric joins Ricardo Semler and Bill Anderson on a lineup the organisers reopened to add him
summary: Corporate Rebels announced on 29 October that they had reopened a completed speaker lineup to add Eric, who will join the Amsterdam summit virtually. The two-day event on 19–20 November brings 350 leaders from more than 30 countries and is members-only; it doubles as the network's ten-year anniversary. Co-founder Pim de Morree frames the booking around ownership structures that protect a mission — the summit's own long-running interest — and what it takes to put that into practice. The day Eric speaks has not been announced, and the public programme page did not yet list him when this entry was written.
blockquote: We've fallen in love with ownership structures that protect a company's mission. I'm looking forward to hearing how Eric thinks companies can put this into practice.
blockquote_source: Pim de Morree, co-founder of Corporate Rebels
